author: claude
description: NyhavnHouse(color, floors=3, width=5, depth=7, trim, roof, ridge, door) is a Copenhagen-style terraced townhouse facing south: coloured terracotta walls, white string courses at each floor, 1x2 street and side windows, a brick gable roof with the gable to the street, chimney, ladder between plank floors, beds, chests and lanterns on each storey. width must be odd (>=5). NyhavnRow(count=6, depth=7, quay=5) lines up houses in rotating colours/heights/widths facing a cobbled quay with bollards and lantern posts. build(count) is the 34x21x12 row, ground_level 1. Rotate CLOCKWISE_90 to face the quay west.
name: nyhavn_townhouses
title: Nyhavn harbour townhouses
